event.text: Morning digest, two items. (1) San Antonio update: a software outage on the line. We're dark from next Friday through Monday Mar 22; the line restarts the following working day. (2) Quick heads up from Quanta: the infotainment chip run for Princeton can't make it next Monday. Carrier says next Friday now (severe weather on the route).

impact.headline: 14 builds rescheduled. 122 customer deliveries affected at 41 dealers; 26 Platinum/Gold customers got a loaner, 4 entitled customers are waiting (dealer pool empty).
changed: 14 production orders moved (14 same-plant reschedules, 0 transfers); 14 now build later (avg 4.6 days).
41 dealers told about exactly their affected orders (one message each); 26 loaners assigned.
unchanged: 54 of 60 future production orders at P_TX were not affected and were not moved.
4 other orders at P_IN in the delay window (2027-03-15 to 2027-03-19) build models without CHIP-IVI (['RANGER']), so they were not moved.
52 of 60 future production orders at P_IN were not affected and were not moved.
92 Standard-tier customers: dealer informed, no loaner (policy rule 5).
4 entitled customers did not get a loaner because the dealer's pool ran out: ['CO-00261', 'CO-00284', 'CO-01836', 'CO-01855']
9 dealers have no affected orders and were not contacted.
No lots held, no vehicles stopped from sale (not part of a delay or outage).
